thread:
Maya: Nightly eval (run 1869991200) flagged a big token-entropy spike for redwood-v8 (build bc9f2a). Avg generation length collapsed; lots of empty or 1-token outputs. Anyone able to reproduce? :eyes:
NightlyBot: nightly-run 1869991200 complete — metrics: entropy +37% vs baseline, avg_len -62%, fail_rate 18%. Logs: https://ci.internal/runs/1869991200 — samples attached.
Oscar: I noticed bc9f2a included a tokenizer change (whitespace normalize + merge tweak). pinging @Liam since he ran quantization tests yesterday.
Liam: I'll do a quick diff between bc8e11 and bc9f2a on the eval prompt set. My first guess: detokenizer mapping shift causing stray EOS tokens. Kicking off a local run.
Jena: also check KV-cache / sequence id alignment — if serialization changed we could see truncated outputs. I can repro locally with `--seed 42` and streaming disabled.
Maya: sample failing outputs from nightly (copied):
> Prompt: "Summarize the research paper on transformer scaling."
Output: "\n"
> Prompt: "Translate to French: Hello"
Output: "\n"
This looks like early EOS emission or detokenization returning empty string.
Liam: quick diff from my local stats:
```nmodel redwood-v8@bc8e11 avg_len=48
model redwood-v8@bc9f2a avg_len=18
tokens with EOS at pos<3 increased 0.4% -> 9.8%
```
So extra EOS tokens spike with bc9f2a.
Oscar: bc9f2a commit notes:
- tokenizer.normalize_unicode = true
- adjusted merge rule for special whitespace marker
- vocab size +2
Maybe detokenizer id offsets moved, or the detokenize step maps a new codepoint to EOS id. Strange.
InfraBot: deploy bc9f2a to staging completed 2026-03-17T02:47Z (deploy id dpl-2026-03-17-0247). Rollback path available.
Maya: Triage plan: 1) pin tokenizer to bc8e11 on nightly, 2) rerun full eval, 3) run quantized (int8) vs fp16 to rule out weight/quant issues. I'll open a small PR to pin tokenizer for the nightly job.
Jena: I ran a local int8 vs fp16 smoke — int8 shows the same early-EOS symptom, fp16 also affected on the staging build, so this strongly points to tokenizer/detokenizer (not quant). Also observed the issue more when using streaming endpoints vs non-streaming.
Liam: eval run 1869991800 started with tokenizer pinned to bc8e11, feeding same prompt set. If that fixes it we should roll back bc9f2a tokenizer change.
Maya: thanks — tagging eng-platform to hold traffic/rollout. Will post run link once it finishes. :thumbsup:
NightlyBot: eval 1869991800 finished — avg_len restored to 47, fail_rate 1.2%. Pinning tokenizer to bc8e11 mitigates the regression.
Oscar: opening rollback/incident doc and notifying support. Will coordinate a safe revert for the tokenizer change and add a postmortem note.
Maya: Closing the loop: revert tokenizer change for next rollout, add a detokenizer checksum preflight in CI, and add a regression test that asserts EOS-rate and avg_len on the fixed prompt set. Great triage team.
